text.tspan: check: no NaN or Inf in train · val · test splits
Run at the start of execute_single_experiment() — before runtime build
Findings sorted FATAL first; WARNs follow
reward_scale = 0 → all rewards zeroed; no learning signal
sample_size > init_rand_steps → buffer empty on first sample (off-policy)
sample_size > buffer_size → mini-batch larger than buffer capacity
PPO: sample_size > frames_per_batch → empty dataloader; updates skip silently
streaming: episode_length > train_size → index error on reset
train_size <= warmup_rows → zero effective training rows after warmup
init_rand_steps overflows buffer (early transitions evicted before any update)
init_rand_steps < 5% of buffer (tiny, correlated warm-up pool)
frames_per_batch > 25% of buffer (high temporal correlation in batches)
optim_steps × sample_size > buffer_size (excessive replay reuse per step)
total gradient updates < 500 (too few weight updates for convergence)
sample_size > frames_per_batch / 4 (mini-batch too large relative to rollout)
ppo_epochs × ⌈frames/sample⌉ > 100 (too many updates; policy collapse risk)
PPO value network narrower than actor
policy_noise > noise_clip (noise always capped; policy_noise ignored)
reward_scale > 100 (large reward magnitudes — check grad clipping)
reward_eta outside [1e-4, 0.5] (EMA barely adapts or forgets instantly)
obs_clip = None (cold-start spikes pass into network)
positions only one unique value (no meaningful action; cannot learn)
positions all non-negative / all non-positive (one-sided market exposure)
0 not in positions (agent can never go flat)
streaming: episode_length > 50% of train_size (too few distinct episodes)
frames_per_batch > train_size (env resets multiple times per batch)
validation_size < eval_steps (eval silently runs fewer steps)
val_size < train_size // 10 (model selection signal too noisy)
eval_steps < 10 (metrics computed on almost no data)
actor_lr or value_lr > 1e-2 (divergence risk with Adam)
eval_interval → < 4 checkpoints over run (learning curve too coarse)
log_interval > eval_interval (loss logs coarser than eval cadence)
log_interval → < 4 log entries over run (nearly blind training)
checkpoint_interval = 0 on long run (crash loses all progress)
continuous_action_thresholds not ordered or outside tanh range
All fatal findings printed to stderr
skip_guardrail_prompts has no effect on fatals
stdin non-interactive (CI/scripts) → log warning, proceed automatically

Rolling deque of length es_stale_policy_window episodes (default 20)
Interpretation: agent has stopped changing positions;
no gradient signal is flowing into the policy
Signal: fraction of steps at non-neutral position (|action| > 0)
Rolling deque of length es_saturation_window episodes (default 20)
Interpretation: agent is always fully long or fully short,
never going flat — stuck at full-exposure saturation
Typical cause: entropy collapse (PPO) or reward
so skewed that always-invested beats neutral
